title: Cushion diamond ring, Dentelle setting, platinum
subtitle: The cushion cut holds fire and warmth in equal measure — its rounded corners and deep pavilion distribute brilliance evenly across the stone's face. The Dentelle setting was built to serve that distribution: arch-shaped prongs connect stone to stone in a continuous lace pattern, so the metal visible around the cushion reads as decoration rather than structure. The stone reads first.
